skill_friction: D2 was skipped because D1 plus org queries fully covered behavior (a formula field with no readers), but SKILL.md only permits skipping D2 when 'D1 already answered its questions'; here org queries, not D1, answered them. The skip criterion should allow org-query coverage.

spec-format says 'with Dynamic Forms, place the field on the FlexiPage; when page activation cannot be read, the layout update is a Conditional: row'. With 4 layouts this produces 4 near-identical Conditional rows; no guidance on whether deploying harmless layout additions unconditionally is preferable.

Audience/persona for field access ('shown on the account' with 45 profiles reading Account.Type, including portal and guest) is arguably an intent question (persona), but step 5 also says enforcement/access mechanism is decided. Unclear which bucket 'who should see a new-on-page field' falls in; I decided (dedicated permission set, internal users) without asking.

Wrong-claim counting: AskCoworker invented example values ('Prospect', 'Customer - Direct') and claimed View All Data gives implicit FLS; SKILL.md does not say whether an illustrative wrong example counts as a 'wrong claim' toward the two-strike threshold.

Permission set that grants field Read must also grant object Read; the design rules do not say whether adding Account Read to a new permission set counts as widening access (it adds nothing for users who already have it via profile).
